The '''Night Imperial''' that was a luxury resort that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Oluna Biqua]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], construction of the resort was completed, and the [[Tourism Council of Oluna Biqua]] invited the [[Heroes of Cularin]] to stay at the Night Imperial for a week's vacation, in commemoration of the resort's grand opening.
